environmentVariables.description: OAuth2 client id.

environmentVariables.description: Set to false to skip the IMAP Sent copy after SMTP. Defaults to true.

environmentVariables.description: What to do on arrival: triage, notify, or none.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_HOOK_ON_NEW_EMAIL

environmentVariables.description: Hook preset: inbox-zero, gtd, priority-focus, notification-only, or custom.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_HOOK_PRESET

environmentVariables.description: Set to true to apply labels from hook triage.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_HOOK_AUTO_LABEL

environmentVariables.description: Set to true to flag mail from hook triage.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_HOOK_AUTO_FLAG

environmentVariables.description: Seconds to batch arrivals before hooks run. Defaults to 5.

environmentVariables.description: Extra instructions appended to the hook preset.

environmentVariables.description: Set to true for desktop notifications.

environmentVariables.description: Set to true to play a sound with desktop notifications.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_ALERT_SOUND

environmentVariables.description: Minimum urgency for an alert: urgent, high, normal, or low.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_ALERT_URGENCY_THRESHOLD

environmentVariables.description: HTTP or HTTPS URL that receives alert POSTs.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL

environmentVariables.description: Set to true to allow webhook targets on a LAN, VPN, or tailnet.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_ALERT_WEBHOOK_ALLOW_PRIVATE

environmentVariables.description: Set to true to create calendar events from hook triage.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_HOOK_AUTO_CALENDAR

environmentVariables.description: Calendar name for automatic events.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_HOOK_CALENDAR_NAME

environmentVariables.description: Minutes before an automatic event to alarm. Defaults to 15.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_HOOK_CALENDAR_ALARM_MINUTES

environmentVariables.description: Set to false to skip confirming automatic calendar events. Defaults to true.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_HOOK_CALENDAR_CONFIRM

environmentVariables.description: Set to true to classify residue mail with System One. Off by default.

environmentVariables.description: HTTP listen address. Defaults to loopback. The host argument wins.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_HTTP_HOST

environmentVariables.description: Bearer token. Required when the HTTP listen address is not loopback or MCP_EMAIL_HTTP_ALLOWED_HOSTS lists a non-loopback name.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_HTTP_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated Host names. Required for 0.0.0.0 and ::.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_HTTP_ALLOWED_HOSTS

environmentVariables.description: Default account name or email address when the account parameter is omitted.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_DEFAULT_ACCOUNT

environmentVariables.description: Toolset profile to register: full, core, or minimal. Defaults to full.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_EMAIL_TOOLSET
